fair_value.method: Horizon-date (Sep-2027) blend on a $5.85/lb realized copper deck (between Citi ~$5.44 and Goldman $6.26 for 2027, below LME spot ~$6.5) and $4,000/oz gold: NTM EV/EBITDA ($710M x 6.0x less ~$175M horizon net debt / 106M shares = $38.5), NTM P/E ($3.75 x 9.5x = $35.6) and a long-term-copper NAV cross-check (~$30.5); weights 0.45/0.35/0.20 give ~$36.0.

methods.name: EV/EBITDA
methods.inputs: NTM (Q4-27 to Q3-28) EBITDA ~$710M: ~83kt Cu (between 2027 outlook 75-85kt and 2028 80-90kt) = ~183M lb x ($5.85 realized - $2.25 C1) = ~$660M, plus Xavantina ~55koz Au x ~$2,500/oz margin = ~$135M, plus tail of historic gold-concentrate sales ~$15M, less ~$100M G&A/exploration/royalties. x 6.0x (current ~5.7x forward; peers 6-7x in a strong deck) = EV $4.26B; less ~$175M horizon net debt (from $452.7M at Q2-26, capex peaking in 2026); / 106M diluted shares

methods.name: P/E
methods.inputs: NTM EPS ~$3.75: EBITDA $710M - D&A ~$165M (Q2-26 run rate $38M/qtr, rising with shaft) - interest ~$35M = $510M pre-tax x 0.78 = ~$398M / 106M shares; x 9.5x (mid-cycle multiple for single-country Brazilian mid-tier producer on a deck near peak). Consensus 2027E EPS $4.79 embeds a higher copper/gold deck and is not used directly.

methods.name: other (NAV at long-term copper)
methods.inputs: Operating NAV ~$3.0B at $4.75/lb LT Cu, $3,000/oz LT Au, 8% real: Caraiba ~42-47ktpa for ~12 yrs post-shaft, Tucuma ~35-40ktpa for ~8 yrs, Xavantina 50-60koz for ~8 yrs; plus Furnas risked ~$0.4B (PEA NPV8 $2.0B is 100% basis; Ero 60% = ~$1.2B before Vale's up-to-11% carry, ~35% risked); less ~$175M horizon net debt; / 106M shares; at ~1.0x P/NAV (peers 0.82-0.95x on $4.00-4.50 decks)

bear.story: Copper falls back toward ~$4.75-5.00/lb realized as the squeeze unwinds and macro slows; the Pilar external shaft slips into 2028 and 2027 guidance comes in below the 75-85kt outlook (another miss); BRL strength after the election pushes C1 toward $2.45; EBITDA ~$500M, multiple compresses to ~5x, net debt stalls near ~$300M.

base.story: Realized copper ~$5.60-6.10/lb; 2026 guidance roughly met, 2027 guidance in the 75-85kt range, shaft commissioned during 2027; C1 ~$2.20-2.35 with BRL collars (floor 5.40) through Dec-2027; net debt ~$100-200M by Sep-2027 and a capital-return framework begins; stock trades ~6x NTM EBITDA.

bull.story: Copper holds $6.3+/lb realized (Goldman's $13,800/t 2027 view or higher), shaft on time lifts Caraiba to 45-50kt path, Tucuma filtration lifts throughput; NTM EBITDA ~$850M+, near net cash, buybacks/dividend, Furnas PFS derisks growth; ~6.5-7x EBITDA.

thesis_break_reason: At $23 the equity is ~$2.45B and EV ~$2.7B with ~$200-300M net debt, about 5x 2027 EBITDA even at a $5.00/lb realized deck (~$550M at 80kt and C1 $2.25) and under 4x at my base deck. Getting there requires copper sustained below ~$4.75/lb (under every current bank 2027 forecast, $5.44-6.26/lb) or a company-specific failure: Pilar shaft slipping past 2027, Tucuma filtration not lifting throughput, or 2027 guidance well below 75-85kt. It is also below where the stock traded before the 2026 copper rally; ordinary 50-64% vol around a ~$36 fair value should rarely reach it on company-neutral news.

reasoning: Round 2 revision. The supervisor showed three errors in my round-1 build: (1) my 2027 C1 of $2.10/lb was below 2026 guidance ($2.15-2.35) and Q2-26 actual ($2.42); (2) my ~$250M end-2027 net debt was too high given $452.7M at Q2-26 and capex peaking in 2026; (3) my $5.50 deck sat at the bottom of bank 2027 views (I verified Goldman raised 2027 to $13,800/t in June 2026 from $10,750; Citi base ~$12,000/t). I also confirmed from the Q2-26 MD&A the $5.78 realized price, $2.42 C1, $450M BRL collars to Dec-2027, 105.9M diluted shares and D&A ~$38M/qtr. Net effect: C1 correction removes ~$100M of EBITDA vs my round-1 $780M, which was internally inconsistent; the deck move ($5.50 -> $5.85) and using NTM (2027-28 blended volumes) at the horizon add most of it back; lower net debt adds ~$0.7/share; Furnas risked at ~$0.4B on the 60% attributable basis. I raised the EV/EBITDA multiple slightly (5.5x -> 6.0x on NTM) since the market already pays ~6.5x my EBITDA and the balance sheet will be much cleaner, and cut the NAV weight 0.25 -> 0.20 because keeping 25% on a long-term-deck NAV while also using a sub-spot near-term deck double-counts mean reversion. Fair value moves $35.5 -> $36.0. I stay ~$1.5 below the supervisor's $37.5 because I use $5.85 rather than $6.00 realized (Ero realizes below LME and spot is at a record) and because the company has no 2027 cost/capex guidance and a guidance-miss history. I did not find filed evidence that the CMD changed the 75-85kt / 80-90kt outlook (CMD transcript paywalled). Distribution: lognormal, median ~$36.5, sigma 0.50 (below realized 64% as leverage falls), slightly fattened far-left tail; gives P(>=38) ~0.47 and P(<23) ~18%, consistent with 25/50/25 scenarios at $21/$37/$56. Research limited to ~6 follow-up lookups.
